Plan (technical):
- Inventory triage: mark records with non-standard signer metadata (we found ~18 rows with custom metadata keys). We'll tag those as 'manual'.
- Staging: create a short-lived S3 presign window (48h) scoped to bucket redwood-prod-vendor-uploads/greenfield/whistic-migrate/ and supply Whistic with the presign manifest.
- API ingestion: for auto-mappable rows we will call the Whistic ingestion endpoint in batches (200 records / job) during their slack window (they said 10/20 -> 10/31).
- Proof capture: enable their webhook to post to /integrations/whistic/migration-confirm which will write a signed transaction to our evidence ledger (hash + timestamp).

Compliance notes / risks:
- Delegation agreements: any transfer of signer rights must include an assertion of chain-of-custody and the original signature hash. Draft looks good; legal should redline but technically workable.
- Redaction: if Greenfield asks to redact customer PII in PDFs, we'll maintain an unredacted original in encrypted S3 and provide redacted copy to Whistic.

2) Marissa: confirm legal contact for delegation agreement.
3) Karthik: confirm KMS key with HSM-backed rotation for the evidence ledger (see note below).
